source_tables.title: EXHIBIT A – TABLE OF PLAN COVERAGE

notes: The document does not publish the distribution of retired members by 5-year age band. It only provides aggregate counts and average monthly benefits for the entire population of Service Retirees, Disabled Retirees, and Beneficiaries. The target grid requires age-specific bins (50-54, 55-59, etc.) which are not available in any table in this report. The closest available data is the aggregate summary found on page 50.
